text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - canary preflight validations failing for release v2026.03.17-snapshot. 5 hosts reporting snapshot hash mismatch and resulting validation 502s. auto-score: HIGH.

maria: seeing repeated "snapshot-mismatch" in the preflight job. Canary pool-3. Errors started ~4765432088.

kevin: confirmed on grafana - validation failure rate ~12% for canary, latency ok. No obvious OOMs.

maria: looks like the snapshot artifact uploaded during the rollout is different across nodes. checksum differs on ingress nodes.

lucy: customer-facing impact? any 5xx at API gateway level?

kevin: yes - a small fraction of generation requests get a 502 when routed to affected backends. Proxy retries cover most, but some timed out. Roughly ~0.3% of total requests in the canary region.

maria: i'll attempt coordinated rollback of the artifact and flip the preflight feature flag if rollback not immediate. tagging @oncall-night for handoff if this extends.

ash: if we flip the flag, we need to ensure cache invalidation for /models/snapshots. Suggest running: 
```
redwood-ctl fflag set disable_preflight_snapshot true --env canary --reason "snapshot mismatch ongoing"
```

devops-bot: executed: redwood-ctl fflag set disable_preflight_snapshot true --env canary --by maria --id cb-4765. Result: queued.

maria: running artifact rollback now: 
```
redwood-ctl deploy rollback --artifact v2026.03.16-snapshot --pool canary-pool-3 --force
```

devops-bot: rollback job started (job id 4765432115). Rolling back snapshot on 5 hosts sequentially. Expected ETA ~4m.

oliver: monitoring logs, will surface any hosts that don't converge. Also starting quick smoke: /health/generation on each node.

kevin: updating customer-impact doc, low blast radius but notify SRE oncall and support to watch for error reports. PM/Support notify: @pm-raj.

pm-raj: acknowledged. Will prepare short update for affected customers if this persists beyond 15m.

maria: rollback completed on 4/5 hosts, one host still shows old hash mismatch, investigating connectivity to object-store.

ash: trying hard restart of agent on host canary-3b: 
```
ssh canary-3b -- sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent && tail -n 100 /var/log/redwood/agent.log
```

devops-bot: agent restarted on canary-3b, agent log shows successful artifact fetch, validation passed.

maria: all hosts converged. preflight validations now green. Rolling back fflag toggle to re-enable preflight after verification.

devops-bot: redwood-ctl fflag set disable_preflight_snapshot false --env canary --by maria --id cb-4765-undo. Result: queued.

kevin: can we mark this as resolved and start incident follow-up? Root cause likely partial artifact propagation during the deploy job; suggest adding stronger checksum validation and a short wait after artifact publish before rolling out.

lucy: agree - capture timeline and owners for postmortem. I'll open an incident doc. tagging @maria, @ash, @oliver for RCA.

maria: handing off to oncall-night in 10m for watch. Leaving runbook notes in the thread and incident doc.

pm-raj: thanks team. No customer escalations so far, will keep communications draft ready if needed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager cleared (incident duration ~4m, mitigation: rollback + agent restart). Incident severity: SEV2 -> monitoring.

maria: filing postmortem checklist now. Will include action items: upload atomic artifacts with immutable names, add checksum gate to deploy pipeline, and adjust canary preflight timeout and retry logic.

kevin: thumbs up. Handoff complete.
